description: This file defines the class DataElementFile in the Thunder::Core namespace, which is a derived class of DataElement. The class manages file-related operations such as opening, closing, reloading, unlinking, and destroying files. It encapsulates a File object and provides methods for file info retrieval, permission management, and memory mapping. It serves as a core component for handling data elements associated with files within the Thunder project.

classes.name: Thunder::Core::DataElementFile
classes.description: A class representing a data element that encapsulates file operations, including opening, closing, reloading, unlinking, and destroying files. It provides interfaces to retrieve file information, handle permissions, and manage memory-mapped files.
